pack: EdgeDesk men's college basketball quantitative data pack
scope: NCAA men's basketball, end-year seasons 2024-2026 (2023-24 to 2025-26): ESPN schedules, team and player boxes, 2026 shots; publisher-derived NCAA team/player boxes, 2026 possessions, lineups and matchup stints; publisher RAPM; name-based participation rosters; team identity bridge; EdgeDesk measured and lagged features; cross-source discrepancy audit
extraction: all three archives extracted into one parent; the shared documentation is identical across parts and the 34 tables are partitioned, not duplicated (PARTS.json)
verification: every table's SHA-256 and row count are checked against sources/inventory.json each time the research engine reads it (basketball/ncaam_research/lib/pack.js); a mismatch stops the run
not_executed_reason: the pack is data, not code this repository runs; the research engine reads the Parquet files through hockey/tools/parquet_select.py (pyarrow) and re-derives what it needs
known_at: blank: first publication of each game record is not in the pack and is never backdated
